name: Phone P-011 usage admission/reconciliation mutation guards (D-021 USD 10/month cap)
command: bash .papercusp/scratch/p011-probes.sh  # papercusp root; one iteration per entry in probes[]

scripts/mutation-probe.sh --file "$file" --relocation overlay --mutate "$mutate" --test "cd $PHONE_APP_ROOT/$dir && npx vitest run $tests"  # $file=probes[].subject, $tests=probes[].tests, mutation described in probes[].mutation
summary: 10/10 copy-out overlay mutants CAUGHT. Every probe ran an unmutated baseline and an unmutated relocated-copy baseline (both green: data 45/45, sidecar 72/72) before its mutant; each mutant produced >=1 targeted failure in phone-app's own Vitest. Covers spend cap (R-56/OUTCOME), destination allowlist (R-52), rate (R-53), concurrency (R-54), duration (R-55), entitlement (R-9), attribution (R-57), reconciliation (R-58), duplicate-event dedup (R-59) and the sidecar production caller (R-12/R-74/OUTCOME). One extra sidecar-e2e probe is a harness-error (embedded PG shutdown deadline inside the overlay namespace) and is NOT scored; see harnessErrors. Live carrier billing / Telnyx CDR reconciliation / public PSTN not covered (D-020 key absent). The driver script was an uncommitted scratch file; the per-probe subject, mutation, tests and counts are recorded below.

assertions.evidence: packages/data/src/usage.ts hard-cap mutant: baseline 45/45, copy 45/45, mutant 3 failed | 42 passed
packages/data/src/usage.ts destination-allowlist mutant: baseline 45/45, copy 45/45, mutant 2 failed | 43 passed
packages/data/src/usage.ts rate-limit mutant: baseline 45/45, copy 45/45, mutant 1 failed | 44 passed
packages/data/src/usage.ts concurrency mutant: baseline 45/45, copy 45/45, mutant 1 failed | 44 passed
packages/data/src/usage.ts duration-cap mutant: baseline 45/45, copy 45/45, mutant 2 failed | 43 passed
packages/data/src/usage.ts entitlement mutant: baseline 45/45, copy 45/45, mutant 2 failed | 43 passed
packages/data/src/usage.ts attribution mutant: baseline 45/45, copy 45/45, mutant 2 failed | 43 passed
packages/data/src/usage.ts reconciliation mutant: baseline 45/45, copy 45/45, mutant 3 failed | 42 passed
packages/data/src/usage-store.ts duplicate-event mutant: baseline 45/45, copy 45/45, mutant 2 failed | 43 passed
apps/sidecar/src/calls.ts reservation-bypass mutant: baseline 72/72, copy 72/72, mutant 1 failed | 71 passed (prepares one outbound intent for retries and refuses another tenant's number)

subjectRepository: phone-app harness repository (~/.papercusp-workspaces/papercusp-workspace/.papercusp/apps/phone-app); every probes[].subject/tests path is relative to that root. Mirror of phone-app/docs/evidence/phone-p011-usage-mutations-2026-10-06.json.
decision: D-021 hard spend cap USD 10.00/month per tenant
method: papercusp scripts/mutation-probe.sh copy-out --relocation overlay: the mutant is bound over the real source path inside a private mount namespace, so the shared tree is never mutated. Each probe ran an unmutated baseline, an unmutated relocated-copy baseline, then the mutant, with phone-app's own Vitest.
scope: Falsifiability of the P-011 usage admission/reconciliation guards and of the sidecar production caller. Live carrier billing, provider CDR reconciliation against a real Telnyx account and public PSTN outcomes are NOT covered (blocked on D-020 TELNYX_API_KEY).
